# tokens/build

**Generated output — do not edit or hand-merge.**

Regenerate after changing any token in `tokens/base` or `tokens/semantic`:

```bash
npm run tokens:build
```

Files:

- `tokens.css` — CSS custom properties for `:root` (light) and `[data-theme="dark"]`
- `tailwind-theme.css` — Tailwind CSS v4 `@theme inline` mapping (colors, radii, fonts, text sizes)
